title: Total cost of ownership over a five period life cycle at 10%
source: Capex 1000 today; operating 100 in each of periods 1..5; maintenance 50 in periods 2 and 4; residual value 200 in period 5
hand_computation: Capex share of the gross PV = 1000 / 1454.5517 = 68.75%
tolerance: Exact cases are compared as text, character for character. Hand-computed cases state the result rounded the way the module rounds (half away from zero): money to 2 decimals, IRR in percent to 6, payback periods and ratios to 4. The module computes with exact rationals, so a stated value must match after that rounding; an independent floating point check of the same case is allowed a difference of 1e-6 relative.
